summary: Autohome Inc. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) on August 20, 2026, containing its unaudited second-quarter and interim 2026 results and updated buyback disclosures. Q2 2026 revenue was RMB1,198.0 million versus RMB1,758.1 million year-over-year, with net income attributable to Autohome of RMB247.8 million. The prior US$200 million repurchase program, effective March 5, 2026, completed July 30, 2026, repurchasing 10,627,269 ADSs. On July 28, 2026, the board authorized a new up to US$400 million buyback over 12 months; 1,895,093 ADSs repurchased for about US$43.6 million as of August 14, 2026. Watch pace relative to the new authorization and any resulting float overhang.
